fact: The Commission de Régulation des Dysfonctionnements launched the DenonciationPro online platform, announced 23 February 2026, for citizens to report confidentially dysfunctions in public administration in about five minutes.

Burkina Faso's public-service ministry officially launched on 5 March 2019 a complaints and suggestions system for users of ministries, including the online form at plaintes.gov.bf, with a 10-day response deadline; no case numbers are given.

Burkina Faso's 2017-2019 OGP commitment BF0005 plans complaint-recording mechanisms in 5 ministerial departments and an online platform to collect complaints directly; the IRM review lists completion as pending.
